representative_selection.eligibility: at least 8 completed discovery trades and not bankrupt

decision.reason: The development-selected event consensus did not pass confirmation monthly return, drawdown, and cost-stress gates.

limitations: 2026 has been viewed in prior studies and is not a fresh independent holdout.
Portfolio drawdown is measured at daily closes; components retain 4h-bar drawdown.
Liquidation, market impact, exchange failure, and shared margin are not modeled.
